title: Inside the Vault
text: You've made it to the vault! You must fight your way through to claim your prize!
dmNotes:
# Who's in this scene

- Lucien Voss (if the party hasn't killed him)
- The party

# What you need to do

Conduct the combat with the dragon.

Once the dragon and wraiths are defeated, if Lucien is still alive:

- Say that Lucien droped something on his way to collect his portion of the treasure
- If the party investigates it, tell the party it was a piece of jewelery or an item that Gideon always had on him. Like a ring or a golden locket or something.

This will show Lucien's involvement in Gideon's death.

If the party attacks and kills Lucien, they will find the evidence that they were framed on his corpse.

# Optional wrap up

You can let the party go back to the town square scene and show the evidence to Judge Octavian Rook if you want, to wrap up the story.
